summary: Change Agents Corporation filed an 8-K reporting completion of Phase 2 development of its Catch-Up agentic AI video platform, funded by a $125,000 AWS grant. The project was led by Caylent, an AWS Premier Tier partner, and its completion triggered the funding. Beta testing is expected in September 2026. This is a routine operational update and product development milestone, not a special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or capital event. No deal terms, share prices, or strategic actions are involved. The filing is informational only, with no investor action implications beyond normal progress reporting.
